sentences.en: The tiny yellow flowers are edible as well, and tasty.
sentences.zh: 这些小小的黄花也可以食用，而且味道不错。

sentences.en: That fungus is deadly, but many others are actually edible.
sentences.zh: 这种真菌是有毒的，但很多其他种类实际上是可以食用的。

sentences.en: When fried, these mushrooms are edible and even a treat.
sentences.zh: 油炸过后，这些蘑菇就可以食用了，甚至还能成为一道美味佳肴。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：ed（吃）+ible（可…的）→可食用的
